column1: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a 9x13-inch pan with parchment.
Stir together the flour, oats, brown sugar and salt in a large bowl.
Cut in the butter with a pastry blender or fork until crumbly.
Set aside one quarter of the crumbs; press the rest firmly into the pan.
Warm the dulce de leche in a small saucepan over low heat for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until spreadable.
Spread the dulce de leche over the crust, scatter the toffee bits on top, then sprinkle with the reserved crumbs.
Bake 25–30 minutes until golden, then cool 15 minutes.
Loosen the edges with a knife and let cool completely before cutting into bars.
